---
title: "China-US Congress Tracker"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Tracks recent U.S. congressional activity related to China, with an emphasis on
economy and trade: all China-related bills in the current Congress, committee hearings and meetings, and
activity by high-influence members. Every entry links to its official
[congress.gov](https://www.congress.gov) page. Data is refreshed hourly from the
[Congress.gov API](https://api.congress.gov).

```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressMessages({
  library(jsonlite)
  library(reactable)
  library(htmltools)
})

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0L) b else a

safe <- function(x, fallback = "") {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L || is.na(x[1])) fallback else as.character(x[1])
}

read_json <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
}

chr_vec <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(character(0))
  if (is.list(x)) {
    return(vapply(x, function(y) if (is.null(y) || length(y) == 0L) "" else as.character(y[1]), character(1)))
  }
  as.character(x)
}

esc <- htmlEscape

link_html <- function(url, text) {
  if (is.null(url) || is.na(url) || !nzchar(url)) return(esc(text))
  sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>', esc(url), esc(text))
}

bills <- read_json("data/bills.json")
meetings <- read_json("data/meetings.json")
members <- read_json("data/members.json")
meta <- read_json("data/meta.json")

count <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) 0L else length(x)
```

**Last updated:** `r safe(meta$generated_at)` |
**Congress:** `r safe(meta$congress)` |
**Bills:** all of the `r safe(meta$congress)`th Congress |
**Hearings window:** `r safe(meta$meeting_lookback_hours)` hours

## Bills (`r count(bills)`)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bills
bill_df <- data.frame(
  Bill = vapply(bills %||% list(), function(b) paste0(safe(b$bill), " ", safe(b$number)), character(1)),
  Title = vapply(bills %||% list(), function(b) safe(b$title), character(1)),
  Action = vapply(bills %||% list(), function(b) safe(b$latest_action), character(1)),
  Date = vapply(bills %||% list(), function(b) safe(b$latest_action_date), character(1)),
  Focus = vapply(bills %||% list(), function(b) if (isTRUE(b$is_econ_trade)) "Trade/Economy" else "", character(1)),
  Sponsors = vapply(bills %||% list(), function(b) {
    paste(chr_vec(lapply(b$sponsors, function(s) s$fullName)), collapse = "; ")
  }, character(1)),
  url = vapply(bills %||% list(), function(b) safe(b$url), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (nrow(bill_df) > 0) {
  reactable(
    bill_df,
    columns = list(
      Bill = colDef(width = 110),
      Title = colDef(html = TRUE, minWidth = 320, cell = function(value, index) link_html(bill_df$url[index], value)),
      Action = colDef(minWidth = 260),
      Date = colDef(width = 110),
      Focus = colDef(width = 120),
      Sponsors = colDef(minWidth = 200),
      url = colDef(show = FALSE)
    ),
    searchable = TRUE,
    striped = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 25,
    highlight = TRUE
  )
}
```

## Committee hearings & meetings (`r count(meetings)`)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-meetings
meet_df <- data.frame(
  Date = vapply(meetings %||% list(), function(m) substr(safe(m$date), 1, 10), character(1)),
  Committee = vapply(meetings %||% list(), function(m) paste(chr_vec(m$committees), collapse = "; "), character(1)),
  Type = vapply(meetings %||% list(), function(m) safe(m$type), character(1)),
  Status = vapply(meetings %||% list(), function(m) safe(m$status), character(1)),
  Title = vapply(meetings %||% list(), function(m) safe(m$title), character(1)),
  url = vapply(meetings %||% list(), function(m) safe(m$url), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (nrow(meet_df) > 0) {
  reactable(
    meet_df,
    columns = list(
      Date = colDef(width = 110),
      Committee = colDef(minWidth = 200),
      Type = colDef(width = 130),
      Status = colDef(width = 110),
      Title = colDef(html = TRUE, minWidth = 340, cell = function(value, index) link_html(meet_df$url[index], value)),
      url = colDef(show = FALSE)
    ),
    searchable = TRUE,
    striped = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 25,
    highlight = TRUE
  )
}
```

## Members (`r count(members)`)

```{r}
#| label: tbl-members
member_activity_html <- function(m) {
  leg <- m$legislation
  if (is.null(leg) || length(leg) == 0L) return("<em>No recent China-related bills</em>")
  items <- vapply(leg, function(l) {
    date <- safe(l$latest_action_date)
    suffix <- if (nzchar(date)) paste0(" | ", date) else ""
    sprintf(
      "<li>%s <small>(%s%s)</small></li>",
      link_html(l$url, safe(l$title)), safe(l$role), suffix
    )
  }, character(1))
  paste0("<ul>", paste(items, collapse = ""), "</ul>")
}

member_df <- data.frame(
  Member = vapply(members %||% list(), function(m) safe(m$name), character(1)),
  State = vapply(members %||% list(), function(m) paste(safe(m$partyName), safe(m$state), sep = " / "), character(1)),
  Role = vapply(members %||% list(), function(m) safe(m$note), character(1)),
  Activity = vapply(members %||% list(), member_activity_html, character(1)),
  Count = vapply(members %||% list(), function(m) length(m$legislation), integer(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (nrow(member_df) > 0) {
  reactable(
    member_df,
    columns = list(
      Member = colDef(minWidth = 160),
      State = colDef(width = 150, name = "Party / State"),
      Role = colDef(minWidth = 220),
      Activity = colDef(html = TRUE, minWidth = 420, name = "Recent China-related activity"),
      Count = colDef(width = 80)
    ),
    searchable = TRUE,
    striped = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 50,
    highlight = TRUE
  )
}
```

## Notes

- **Source:** the official [Congress.gov API](https://api.congress.gov). Every row links to its official congress.gov page.
- **Relevance** is determined by legislative subject tags, policy areas, and keyword lists in [`R/fetch.R`](R/fetch.R) - tune the lists there to widen or narrow coverage.
- **Members** combine a curated watchlist ([`config/members.csv`](config/members.csv)) with members auto-added because they sponsor recent China-related bills. Watchlist members with no China-related bills this Congress are dropped.
- "Sponsor/Cosponsor" member activity uses title-keyword matching (plus cross-reference to subject-verified bills), so a bill whose China relevance lives only in its subject tags may occasionally be missed in that section.
